title: Maneuvers
description: Combat maneuvers: a way to perform an action (today an attack) for more or fewer AP, with an attack and damage change and effects from the shared pool, at no mana or little (docs/core/actions.md#maneuvers, M3-24).

modifies.description: The action the maneuver is a way of performing, a key in actions/core.json; its AP is that action's cost plus `ap`, and an action that adds to the attack (aimed) costs the attack's AP plus its own (Held Breath, GD_S17_06).

ap.description: AP added to the action's cost, negative for a faster one; never below 1 in total. In real time it is stamina at stamina_per_ap (docs/core/actions.md#one-rule-set-two-clocks).

mana.description: A small mana cost, for a maneuver with a touch of magic; 0 for most.

attack.description: Added to the attack roll's target, as a called shot's attack.

damage_multiplier.description: Multiplies the damage after the called shot, rounded down.

ranges.description: The attack ranges it works at; any range when left out.

weapon_properties.description: The weapon must have one of these properties (the weapon `properties` in equipment); any weapon when left out.

save_bonus.description: Makes the maneuver an attempt (GD_S05_04): after a hit, the defender saves against the DC, the weapon's attribute x maneuver_save_multiplier plus this bonus; its effects and events land on a failed save (docs/core/actions.md#the-maneuver-attempt). A rider's attempt has no bonus. A maneuver without it lands its effects on any hit.

events.description: What a landed attempt does beyond effects, for the caller to apply: `disarm` is the target dropping its weapon, the event the arms called shot names (GD_S05_04).

command.description: The command that runs the maneuver, `combat` when left out; another command refuses it (docs/core/actions.md#ranged-maneuvers, GD_S17_06).

strikes.description: Strikes the maneuver makes, for an attack_sequence row (Split Nock), each at `attack`; one when left out.

rounds.description: Rounds of ammunition one use spends, one when left out, so the count stays exact (GD_S17_02).

loadouts.description: Main-hand kinds the maneuver needs (attack_sequences' kinds, such as bow); any when left out.

crit_window.description: Added to the attacker's crit window for this attack.

range_normal_min.description: The weapon's range_normal must be at least this (the combat input's attacker.range_normal).

still.description: Refused when the attacker moved this turn (the combat input's moved).

without_weapon_properties.description: Refused with a weapon that has any of these properties (Pinning Fire and loading).

spends_all.description: The maneuver spends all the AP left, which must be at least its cost (overwatch).

hold.description: A hold on the pool: the cost is reserved from held AP and comes back when nothing draws the shot (overwatch).

attack.description: Added to the attack of a foe that attacks from inside the zone, for the caller.

zone.description: A zone held under fire until the shooter's next turn: the first move of each foe in it or into it draws a strike at `attack`, while the rounds last (overwatch).

effects.description: Applied on a hit that is not evaded, as a called shot's riders; each effect must declare the `maneuver` channel.
